answer: In this PoA design, each identity’s reputation follows exponential temporal decay: every half-life halves past evidence, so sustained honest service is required to build durable weight. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagate trust only through established edges; freshly spawned sybil identities, each a vertex, have near-zero eigenvector centrality, whether labeled timber or hidden in a garden, and therefore cannot accumulate quorum support or pass consensus.
